name: jr-uptime
description: Pings your sites every 2 minutes; a red band above the prompt the moment one goes down, and /jruptime with latency sparklines and the last incident.

urls.title: URLs to watch
urls.description: Separated by commas, e.g. example.com, api.example.com/health

showWhenUp.title: Show the band when all is up
showWhenUp.description: Off: the band appears only when a site is down. On: a green dot per site the rest of the time.
